title: 第13章 神霞宗遭劫起源道解与起源道体第14章 傀儡黑大新任务发布
slug: 签到大帝修为开局收下禁忌剑体
content_zh:
东荒域偏东北一地。
神霞宗。
此时位于神霞宗大殿内的众人惊呆了，他们完全想不到竟敢有人如此大胆，当着他们的面杀了他们神霞宗长老。
最令人气愤的是，此人最后居然还关闭了空间通道，不给他们反应的机会。
就好比世俗中两人吵架，一人对着另一人输出一通之后，竟然跑了。
不给另一人反骂的机会，当真气死人不可。
“宗主此人太过嚣张，欺我神霞宗太甚，一定要找到，随后将其挫骨扬灰。”
“对啊宗主，不杀此人，难正我神霞宗之威名。”
“宗主我请求带队，亲自将此人抓回我神霞宗！”
殿内众长老纷纷开口道，无不气愤，这是他们神霞宗开宗以来，第一次遭受奇耻大辱。
坐在主位上的神霞宗宗主，此时神色阴沉，他也知道此人太过嚣张。
可他乃是尊者九重天的实力，连他都做不到一指点杀尊者三重天的蓝长老。
那么此人实力究竟到了何等地步？
于是他将情况说给了在场众长老。
众人无言，一尊通天大能他们惹不起的，难道就这么算了？
就当众人沉默之际。
忽然，神霞宗主猛然抬头，看向大殿之外，身影一闪，其余长老也紧随其后。
众人出现在大殿上空，他们见到了此生难以看到的景象，一只万丈大小的巨拳正向他们神霞宗袭来。
“咻！
咻！

咻！
......”
一位位气势滔天的老者出现在他们身旁，全部都是通天境修为，为首的老者甚至达到了通天境七重天。
“神霞宗上下所有人听令，随我一起抵挡！”
为首的老者乃是神霞宗现存于世的老祖，他本来在禁地中闭关，突然感到不安，将他从闭关中惊醒。
通天境七重天的实力全力爆发，随后开启了神霞宗护宗大阵—神霞极光阵，此阵乃是神霞宗开宗老祖所留，能抵挡数位通天九重天的全力攻击。
可是尽管大阵全力撑开，以及以神霞宗老祖为首的众人全力爆发，召唤出一件件法宝，打出绝世杀招。
在这恐怖巨拳面前，一切都是纸糊的，大阵仅仅坚持了一瞬，就立马破碎。
而众人的攻击好像是蜉蝣撼树，对巨拳一点影响都没有。
轰！
轰！
轰！
爆炸声不断从神霞宗内传出。
片刻后，神霞宗一片狼烟，山门被毁，数不清的宫殿倒塌，山峰倒了无数座。
content_en:
A place in the northeast of the Eastern Wasteland.
Shenxia Sect.
At this time, everyone in the Shenxia Sect's main hall was stunned. They had no idea that someone would be so bold as to kill their Shenxia Sect elders in front of them.
The most irritating thing is that this person actually closed the space channel in the end, not giving them a chance to react.
It's like two people quarreling in the world. After one person hits the other person, he runs away.
Not giving the other person a chance to retaliate would be really annoying.
"The sect leader is too arrogant and has bullied our Shenxia Sect too much. We must find him and crush him to ashes."
"Yes, sect master, if we don't kill this person, it will be difficult to correct the reputation of our Shenxia Sect."
"Sect Master, I request to lead the team and personally capture this person back to our Shenxia Sect!"
All the elders in the hall spoke one after another, and they were all angry. This was the first time that their Shenxia Sect had suffered such humiliation since the founding of the sect.
The leader of Shenxia Sect, who was sitting on the main seat, looked gloomy at this time. He also knew that this person was too arrogant.
But he has the strength of the Venerable Ninth Heaven, and even he cannot kill Elder Lan, who is the Venerable Third Heaven.
So how strong is this person?
So he told the situation to all the elders present.
Everyone was speechless. They couldn't afford to offend a powerful person like the Heaven. Could it be that they just let it go?
When everyone was silent.
Suddenly, the leader of the Shenxia Sect suddenly raised his head and looked outside the hall. His figure flashed, and the other elders followed closely behind.
Everyone appeared in the sky above the main hall, and they saw a sight that was difficult to see in this life. A giant fist the size of ten thousand feet was attacking their Shenxia Sect.
"Phew!
Phew!
Phew!
..."
One by one, powerful old men appeared beside them, all of whom were at the Heaven-Bearing Realm. The leading old man had even reached the seventh level of the Heaven-Blasting Realm.
"Everyone in the Shenxia Sect, listen to the order and resist with me!"
The old man at the head was the living ancestor of the Shenxia Sect. He had been in seclusion in the forbidden area, but he suddenly felt uneasy and woke up from the seclusion.
The strength of the seventh-level Tongtian realm exploded with all its strength, and then the Shenxia Sect's sect-protecting formation—the Shenxia Aurora Formation was launched. This formation was left by the founder of the Shenxia Sect and could withstand the full-force attacks of several Tongtian ninth-level heavens.
However, even though the formation was fully opened and everyone led by the ancestor of the Shenxia Sect exploded with all their strength, they summoned magic weapons one after another and launched a peerless killing move.
In front of this terrifying giant fist, everything was paper. The formation only lasted for a moment and then immediately shattered.
But everyone's attacks seemed like mayflies shaking the tree, and had no effect on the giant fist at all.
boom!
boom!
boom!
Explosions continued to be heard from Shenxia Sect.
A moment later, the Shenxia Sect was in chaos, the mountain gate was destroyed, countless palaces collapsed, and countless mountains fell.
